captions.detailed: A realistic, highly detailed bell tower with a substantial brown architectural frame, a dark grey base and roof, and a visible bronze-colored bell mount. The structure features a tall rectangular column base supporting a four-pillared belfry topped with a dark pyramidal roof. Inside the belfry, a realistic bell is suspended from a horizontal wooden-style beam, designed to articulate naturally with realistic rotational movement.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic, highly detailed bell tower with a substantial architectural frame, a dark base, a tall brown tower silhouette, and a dark pyramidal roof. Inside the four-pillared belfry, mount a bronze-colored bell on a horizontal beam designed to rotate realistically.
captions.factory: Create the base structure using a dark grey Box primitive. Build the main tower column using a taller brown Box, and construct the belfry frame on top using corner posts, a mid-trim box, and a pyramidal roof shape. Model the bell assembly as a separate part containing a horizontal mounting cylinder (or beam) and a bell-shaped revolve/loft, and connect it to the main frame using a revolute joint to allow realistic swinging.
